cb_step_1.title: Fibula graft side
cb_step_1.instruction: Tick the "Right side leg" checkbox if the fibula graft is taken from the right leg.

cb_step_2.title: Select mandibular segmentation
cb_step_2.instruction: In "Select mandibular segmentation", choose the segmentation that contains the mandible.

cb_step_3.title: Select fibula segmentation
cb_step_3.instruction: In "Select fibula segmentation", choose the segmentation that contains the fibula.

cb_step_4.title: Select current scalar volume
cb_step_4.instruction: In "Current Scalar Volume", choose the Mandible Volume.

cb_step_5.title: Create bone models
cb_step_5.instruction: Click "Create bone models from segmentations" to build the mandible and fibula models.

cb_step_7.title: Show red slice in 3D view
cb_step_7.instruction: For the red slice view, toggle on "slice visibility in 3D view" to render the red slice plane in the 3D view.

cb_step_8.title: Match red slice FOV to 2D spacing
cb_step_8.instruction: For the red view, toggle on "FOV, Spacing match 2D".

cb_step_9.title: Enable slice intersection interaction
cb_step_9.instruction: Turn on "slice intersection visibility" in the toolbar, then in the slice intersection options turn on "set interaction" and enable both "Translate" and "Rotate".

cb_step_10.title: Adjust slice intersections
cb_step_10.instruction: Rotate and zoom the 3D view to see the slice intersection lines clearly, then drag the cross lines to translate and rotate them into the desired position in the views.

cb_step_11.title: Add mandibular curve
cb_step_11.instruction: Click "Add mandibular curve" to create the mandibular curve.

cb_step_12.title: Set curve display views
cb_step_12.instruction: In the Markups module, under "Advanced", set the view for the mandibular curve to "3D View 1" and "Red".

cb_step_13.title: Draw mandibular curve
cb_step_13.instruction: In the Red view, click along the mandible to draw the curve.

cb_step_15.title: Hide red slice from 3D view
cb_step_15.instruction: For the red slice view, toggle off "slice visibility in 3D view".

cb_step_16.title: Number of mandibular cut planes
cb_step_16.instruction: Enter how many mandibular cut planes you want to create.

cb_step_17.title: Add mandibular cut plane
cb_step_17.instruction: Click "Add cut plane" to create this mandibular cut plane.

cb_step_18.title: Place mandibular cut plane
cb_step_18.instruction: Move and rotate this cut plane into position in the view.

cb_step_19.title: Add fibula line
cb_step_19.instruction: Click "Add fibula line" to create the fibula line.

cb_step_20.title: Draw fibula line
cb_step_20.instruction: In 3D View 2, click along the fibula to draw the line, starting with the first point distally and finishing proximally.

cb_step_21.title: Reset red slice field of view
cb_step_21.instruction: Click "Reset field of view" in the red slice view.

cb_step_22.title: Center fibula line on fibula model
cb_step_22.instruction: Click "Center fibula line using fibula model" to align the line with the anatomical axis of the fibula.

cb_step_23.title: Automatic mandibular planes positioning
cb_step_23.instruction: Tick "Automatic mandibular planes positioning for maximum bones contact area".

cb_step_24.title: Rotate mandible planes together
cb_step_24.instruction: Tick "Make all mandible planes rotate together".

cb_step_25.title: Set initial space
cb_step_25.instruction: Enter the desired initial space in millimetres.

cb_step_26.title: Set between space
cb_step_26.instruction: Enter the desired between space in millimetres.

cb_step_27.title: Update fibula planes and generate reconstruction
cb_step_27.instruction: Click "Update fibula planes over fibula line; update fibula bone pieces and transform them to mandible" to create the fibula cut planes and the reconstruction.

cb_step_28.title: Update fibula planes automatically
cb_step_28.instruction: Tick "Update fibula planes over fibula line; update fibula bone pieces and transform them to mandible".

cb_step_29.title: Show mandible cut planes
cb_step_29.instruction: In the "Mandible planes" row, click the eye icon to show the mandibular cut planes.

cb_step_30.title: Show plane interaction handles
cb_step_30.instruction: In the same "Mandible planes" row, click the axes icon to show the plane interaction handles.

cb_step_31.title: Adjust mandibular cut planes
cb_step_31.instruction: In the mandible 3D view, drag the visible plane handles to move and rotate the mandibular cut planes into the desired position.

cb_step_32.title: Hide mandible cut planes
cb_step_32.instruction: In the "Mandible planes" row, click the eye icon again to hide the mandibular cut planes.
